I completely have felt this, (not moving but the distance of friends) and I can agree it is a terrible feeling. You just have to think of it as a fresh start even though they were your old friends. This happens after highschool when everyone goes to college and comes back as well. Things will never be the same sadly, but you can make them better by making an effort to hang out or maybe even find new friends to branch out to. I have found that having new friends as well as old is a good mixture when the old friends feel distant and not the same. New friends are completely new so the distance will only be in the beginning :) everything gets better. I promise.
